⟡ Yggdrasil Guild Hall

The DM's prep and table tools.
⋯

Keep the hooks you like; mark them Final to send their Quest Notices to Print and to the At the Table view. "Paid → treasury" adds the guild fee.

Skill grades: Proficient = Skilled; Expertise = Expert; Expertise at level 11+ = Master. "Proficient (auto)" / "Expertise (auto)" follow a PC's level. Retiring a PC keeps them in the hall as an NPC who can operate a facility.

For the players
DM only
Printing

Campaign file

The campaign file is the source of truth: jobs, upgrades, treasury, roster, write-ups, and any custom tables. The page also keeps a working copy in this browser, but save a file after each prep session and keep the files somewhere safe (Drive, Dropbox, USB).

Backups in this browser

Taken automatically when you save, before loading a file or restoring, and every 5 minutes while you have unsaved changes (last 25 kept). They live in this browser only, so they're a safety net, not a replacement for the campaign file.

Import pasted data

Paste an export from the old Job Board or Upgrade Chart (or a campaign file's contents).

GitHub saves

DM password

Keeps players from wandering into DM View. It travels with the campaign, so after a change, save so other copies pick it up. This isn't strong security: the campaign file itself isn't encrypted.

Guild standing

Display

Layout

Auto uses the phone layout on narrow screens (under 760 px wide). This choice is saved in this browser only.

Claude

The key stays in this browser only; it's never written into the campaign file or this page. Use a dedicated key with a monthly spend limit set in the Claude Console.

Tiers & economy

Tables (JSON)

Open a section to edit it; changes apply when you click Save tables. Upgrade prices are in "jobs" (one Standard job's guild fee at mid-tier); set gp on a level to override. Custom tables travel in the campaign file.

↑↓ to move · Enter to open · Esc to close
